name: Martin’s Specialty
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: 1 cup chopped cooked chicken or veal

steps: Cook onion in butter three minutes.
Add meat and bread crumbs, moisten with stock, and add egg yolk and seasonings.
Wrap in lettuce leaves, allowing two tablespoons mixture to each portion.
Remove to serving dish and pour around Tomato Sauce.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
